messages:
maria: P95 token latency jumping in eu-west-1 since 09:22 UTC, started ~09:18. Dashboard shows 5–8x increase. Traces point to runtime kv_cache hydrate path causing stalls.
akash: Seeing same. Correlates with today's runtime deploy c3b9f2 — changed batching heuristics for short sessions. Repro locally: lots of tiny chat turns => huge dynamic batch sizes.
devon: Incident created. oncall-bot: #INC-2025-042 opened and page sent.
maria: Quick metrics: p50 60ms -> 150ms, p95 180ms -> 1.2s, errors up 0.5% -> 3.4%. Affects both hosted and dedicated pools in eu-west-1.
jin: Can we flip batching to conservative or disable KV cache for eu-west as a quick mitigation? Suggest ROUTER_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024 and KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false.
akash: Preparing routing config change now. curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/route-config -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","batch_policy":"conservative"}' --header 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
devon: Executing on prod-router: kubectl -n rtr set env deploy/router ROUTE_BATCH_POLICY=conservative --context=prod-eu-west && kubectl -n rtr set env deploy/router KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false --context=prod-eu-west
aaron: I'll add capacity to the GPU pool to help drain requests: terraform plan/apply to +2 gpus in eu-west. Starting approval hop.
maria: We should also consider rolling back the runtime change if config flip doesn't help. c3b9f2 looked suspicious in canary logs.
akash: Kicking rollback: /scripts/serve-rollback --version c3b6a8 --region eu-west-1 (started). ETA ~5m.
oncall-bot: deploybot: rollback job started (job id db-8763).
devon: After disabling KV cache and switching batch policy p95 dropped to ~310ms within 4 minutes, backlog draining. Errors heading down.
maria: Good catch. Keep rollback in place until we fix batching heuristic. Need a postmortem and a new perf test that simulates small-turn chat.
jin: I'll file a ticket to add a canary that generates high small-turn volume and a rollout gate. Also adding a runtime safety toggle to cap batch size.
akash: Root cause summary: batching heuristic used average seq length instead of 90th pct, so many tiny sessions got coalesced into oversized batches and triggered KV hydration thrash. Patch in PR #4523 to use percentile and add cap.
devon: Action item: add alert rule when batch_size > 500 for > 30s and when kv_cache_evictions/sec spikes > 1000.
maria: Agree. Re-enable KV cache only after PR merged + canary validated. Leaving incident open for 24h watch. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Thread is a compact incident response for a runtime regression causing KV cache and batching-related latency spikes in eu-west-1. Messages are chronological and Slack-style: short updates, commands, bot notices, and action items. No title field per agents.md rules.
